_comment: Reviewed terms of licenses with no standard text in spdx-standard-licenses.json. A package file covers such a license only when it carries these terms whole (carriesWholeStandardText). The texts come from SPDX license-list-data (text/<id>.txt); for bzip2-1.0.6 the sentence before the conditions and the signature after the disclaimer name the program's holder and version and are left out, as the shipped variants change them.
